data.body: [P2] Preserve SDK timeout names when the cause is synthesized. A callback timeout can contain only `ErrorMessage`, as the local runner's timeout and heartbeat handlers generate. The SDK then constructs `CallbackTimeoutError` with a synthetic cause named `Error`. This check treats that cause as a user exception, changing execution-level `error.name` from `CallbackTimeoutError` to `Error` and breaking timeout classification. Preserve the timeout error's own name even when this synthetic cause exists, and add coverage using the actual message-only timeout payload; the new test constructs a timeout without a cause and misses this path.
